purpose: Locate feature/frame preparation costs while preserving the existing twelve-feature contract and frozen model predictions.

feature_contract.input: Nonempty bytes, including bytes subclasses as accepted by the reference; preserve invalid-input exception class/message.
feature_contract.comparison: Same ordered keys and exact builtin types. Integers exactly equal. Finite float.hex() exactly equal, including signed zero. No epsilon/rounding gate.
feature_contract.frame: One row, columns in names_in_order, float64 values exactly equal to float(reference_feature); same finite-value/schema checks as frozen feature_frame.
feature_contract.floating_point_caution: Counter insertion order, math.fsum input order, statistics mean/pstdev and partial final blocks/segments belong to the reference contract. Algebraically equivalent formulas may change binary64 results.

corpus.selection: All sixty selected files from the frozen source manifest; no replacements or exclusions based on features/times/codec outcomes.
corpus.identity: Inventory full sample_id, candidate_id, original_size, input_sha256, original path, format and origin_group_id. Read/hash-check original bytes before execution; no feature computation during plan preparation.
corpus.saved_features: predictions/samples.csv, all 60 by 12 values, parsed according to the reference builtin type and stored canonically without recomputation.
corpus.saved_predictions: predictions/frozen_predictions.csv, all 60 by 9 by 2 single-row decisions and uncalibrated probability fields.
corpus.models: All eighteen existing files in training.json; verify hashes/runtime/class/settings/feature order before local deserialization. No fit/refit or class balancing.
corpus.interpretation: Observed development corpus, not a new final holdout. Historical accuracy and policy targets are not changed.

correctness_stages: Verify frozen plan/source/input/model hashes and original runtime versions before measurement; abort on mismatch without refreshing expected values.

Use an isolated byte-identical reference feature module and copied config. Recompute all sixty reference feature rows and require exact canonical equality to saved feature values before trusting the runner.

Require instrumented output equal to uninstrumented reference for every invocation. Future candidate implementations must pass the same strict feature/frame gate on the complete corpus and deterministic fixture suite.

Validate all 1080 frozen single-row predictions using all eighteen unchanged models. Require exact predicted_algorithm, class ordering, probability fields and confidence float.hex() agreement; confidence remains uncalibrated.

Future optimization comparison requires both reference and candidate on the same inputs/runtime, unchanged model bytes and identical predictions; altered features require a separate research version and evaluation plan.

timing.aggregate: Median of all five raw slots per file and mode. Preserve warmups separately, every repeat and every failure. Never select favorable repeats.
timing.file_order: For each mode and warmup/measurement round, shuffle the full list sorted by (origin_group_id,sample_id) with a fresh random.Random(schedule_seed + 1000*mode_index + round_index); warmup round_index=0, measurements=1..5.
timing.process_scope: Run each mode in its own fresh worker; imports/model loading/input reads/hash checks outside all feature timers. Data are resident bytes; no CPU-affinity/priority/power-setting changes. Record Python/packages/OS/timer resolution and user-observable run interruptions.

mode_boundaries.extract_only: Uninstrumented frozen extract_features(data), including allocations and its full work; validate returned features after the timer.
mode_boundaries.frame_only: Build one-row frame from prevalidated reference values using the frozen feature_frame definition; include schema and finite checks, exclude extraction.
mode_boundaries.extract_and_frame: Uninstrumented extract_features plus frozen feature_frame; matches the old feature timer's logical scope, but is a new resident-byte measurement and excludes old read/hash work.
mode_boundaries.instrumented_extract: Frozen reference code with process-local timing wrappers for functions/Counter; record inclusive/self times, parent/depth/call count. Restore originals in finally; never patch project files.

timing.nested_accounting: Segment entropy contains segment Counter and entropy calls; global histogram/whole entropy are distinguished by parent context. Sum only direct-child elapsed times to derive parent self time; never sum inclusive parent and child times as disjoint work. Self time includes wrapper/bookkeeping overhead.
timing.instrumentation_caution: Primary durations come from uninstrumented modes. Instrumented times locate candidate hot functions, do not prove production speed. Report observer overhead against extract_only on the same full corpus, including negative/noisy differences; no causal speedup claim.
timing.median_caution: Do not add independent phase medians or subtract them to invent unmeasured stages. Keep combined duration and separate-mode durations distinct.

fixture_plan.generation: For each pattern/length start from a fresh RNG with the declared seed. Random uses Random.randbytes(length), four-byte alphabet uses bytes(Random.randrange(4) per byte); truncate cyclic patterns to exact length.

extra_valid_cases.all_ordered_byte_pairs: b''.join(bytes((a,b)) for a in range(256) for b in range(256)); covers every bigram and saturation/early-exit path
extra_valid_cases.bytes_subclass: A local bytes subclass holding b'ABCABC'; preserve reference acceptance

fixture_plan.failure_policy: Generate expected values only with the frozen reference at execution. Preserve every mismatch with feature/type/hex/input hash, then mark validation failed; no tolerance relaxation or fixture removal.

reporting.all_files: Raw ns, mode/round/warmup flags, full IDs/input hashes, output canonical values, component call tree, self/inclusive times, runtime, source/model hashes and execution Git commit.
reporting.summaries: Per-file five-slot medians; all-file descriptive distributions; format/origin and fixed <=64KiB,(64,256]KiB,>256KiB groups. Report empty/failure coverage and instrumentation overhead. Do not choose a favorable subset.
reporting.decision_rule: Rank reference helper costs only after exact-output and schedule completeness audits. Choose optimization scope from measured full-corpus costs, preserving semantic/equality gates. No speedup/class-share adoption threshold is fitted here.
reporting.future_optimization: Any candidate must be independently snapshotted and compared with reference in a new balanced paired schedule/plan, including equality first. Do not compare a future candidate against historical timing as if runs were paired.
reporting.failure_and_resume: Append explicit error/interrupt evidence. Preserve partial run paths; do not overwrite/retry a failed slot or merge partial attempts into one complete run. A new attempt uses a new path and full schedule.
reporting.boundaries: Official v2 score/models and memory validation_only remain as-is. No retraining, quota adjustment, sample deletion, final generalization claim or deployment is authorized by this profiling plan.

delivery_sequence: Freeze this plan, source snapshots, expected-value inventory, deterministic schedule and hash audit; local commit before implementation/real profiling.
Implement an isolated worker/runner and exact comparison audits; validate on artificial fixtures and commit before corpus timings.
Run all predeclared baseline profile modes in a new output path, preserve full raw evidence and independently verify/report.
Use measured bottlenecks to define a separate exact-feature-preserving optimization and paired validation.
